blocking_findings.risk: Worker can arbitrarily set outcome (including PASS) and compute a valid payload hash, as current validation only checks hash integrity not outcome provenance, fully bypassing required trusted builder outcome derivation.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Remove outcome from the worker-signed/hashed payload schema; enforce outcome is only computed and appended by the trusted builder post-validation of all input receipts, never part of worker-submitted hashable content.
blocking_findings.test: Submit a worker-generated report with self-set outcome=PASS and correctly computed payload hash, confirm validation rejects the report as invalid for containing a worker-supplied outcome field.

blocking_findings.risk: No deterministic outcome precedence and mandatory trigger rules, allowing inconsistent or incorrect outcome derivation (e.g., PASS assigned even with missing required test receipts or unresolved reviews).
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Implement strict non-overridable outcome precedence with explicit mandatory triggers; PASS requires all mandatory checks.
blocking_findings.test: Inject a blocking trigger alongside all PASS-eligible conditions and confirm the derived outcome remains non-PASS.

blocking_findings.risk: Outcome derivation does not require binding to immutable P0R1 V1 report exact byte hashes, allowing tampered legacy reports to be used to derive false PASS outcomes.
blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Require exact full-byte SHA-256 for every legacy adoption input and verify it before classification.
blocking_findings.test: Submit a modified V1 report with a mismatched byte hash and confirm adoption is blocked.

non_blocking_findings.risk: Outcome derivation input lineage is not persisted.
non_blocking_findings.minimal_fix: Persist ordered input receipt digests in the final report.
non_blocking_findings.test: Confirm every derivation input has a content digest in the report.

recommended_next_three_tests: Reject a worker-supplied PASS even when its payload hash is valid.
A missing required receipt prevents PASS.
A legacy report with the wrong exact byte hash cannot be adopted.
avoid_building: UNKNOWN usage converted to zero or a fixed estimate.
